findings.title: Metric alert detector handler cannot be instantiated
findings.body: `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` now inherits `StatefulDetectorHandler` but implements none of its abstract requirements (`counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and `build_occurrence_and_event_data`). When a detector with type `metric_alert_fire` is processed, `Detector.detector_handler` attempts to instantiate this class and raises `TypeError` instead of safely evaluating it (the previous handler returned an empty result). Implement the stateful interface or retain a concrete non-stateful handler returning the new dict result shape.

findings.title: Stateful evaluation documentation still describes the old list return contract
findings.body: The `StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate` docstring says it "returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`", but the method now returns a dictionary keyed by `DetectorGroupKey`. This is the implementation documentation subclass authors will use for the newly changed handler API, so it should describe the keyed mapping and its uniqueness semantics.

findings.title: Multi-group occurrence test does not verify the value passed to the new hook
findings.body: The packet supplies `group_2` with value `10`, but the expected occurrence is built with value `6`. Since `build_mock_occurrence_and_event` does not include `value` in either returned object, this assertion still passes even if `evaluate_group_key_value` invokes `build_occurrence_and_event_data` with the wrong per-group value. Make the mock output/value observable or mock the hook and assert that `group_2` is called with `10`.
